verdict_reason: AlphaEarth embeddings (CC-BY 4.0, GEE catalog, 2017-2025 annual) and CLMS Crop Types + Confidence layer (open Copernicus licence, direct download, 2017-2023 annual) are both accessible with no application, giving 7 overlapping years for a drift study. Ground truth via EuroCrops is open (CC-BY 4.0) but a published harmonization study only validated it for 2017-2021 across 11 countries, and inter...

sources.name: AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding V1 (Google/Google DeepMind)
sources.licence_quote: CC-BY 4.0; attribution required: "produced by Google and Google DeepMind"
sources.coverage_quote: 10-meter pixel resolution globally across terrestrial land surfaces and shallow waters
sources.date_range: 2017-01-01 through 2025-01-01, annual layers covering full calendar years
caveats_quoted: DATASET_VERSION 1.1 includes a regenerated 2017 layer that incorporates additional Sentinel-1 acquisitions

sources.name: CLMS High Resolution Layer Croplands - Crop Types (CTY), 2017-present
sources.licence_quote: Copernicus land monitoring products and services are made available on a principle of full, open and free access
sources.coverage_quote: EEA38 countries plus French Overseas Territories (DOMs), delivered in 100 x 100 km tiles
sources.date_range: 2017-01-01/ ongoing; first release covered 2017-2021, 2022-2023 update completed end of 2025, 2024 release scheduled April 2026
caveats_quoted: post-classification processing steps include spatial (Minimum Mapping Unit: 0.25ha) and temporal filtering to assure a high consistency of the time series
The higher incidence of land use disagreements in the interannual classification occurs within the permanent crop domain
unclassified permanent crops and fruits represent the crop types with the highest percentage of pixels classified as inconsistencies

sources.name: CLMS Crop Types Confidence Layer (CTYCL)
sources.licence_quote: Copernicus land monitoring products and services are made available on a principle of full, open and free access
sources.coverage_quote: The Crop Types (CTY) layer exists for reference years 2017 through 2023 (Table 7-5)
sources.date_range: reference years 2017 through 2023 per Product User Manual Table 7-5
caveats_quoted: CTYCL indicates the degree of confidence of the provided crop type label
The probability value from the winning class as determined by the model is taken as the confidence level
output undergoes spatial cleaning and harmonised over the years to enhance temporal and spatial consistency of the product
does not explicitly state that class definitions or methods remain consistent across years

sources.name: EuroCrops (harmonized self-declared crop reporting reference labels)
sources.coverage_quote: self-declared crop reporting datasets from countries of the European Union
sources.date_range: not stated on landing page; validation studies use EuroCrops v2 for 2017-2021
caveats_quoted: available for the period of 2017-2021 from only 11 countries

sources.name: Harmonizing Copernicus HRL grassland/croplands (interannual consistency study)
sources.coverage_quote: Europe wide agricultural land use systems by harmonizing the Copernicus High Resolution Layers on grassland and croplands
caveats_quoted: Uncertainty in detecting ploughing may lead to a false interpretation of land use change, rather than indicating temporary grassland within the rotation
